# Parc Montsouris (07156)

```{r echo = F}
read_delim(paste0("https://www.meteo60.fr/stations-releves/station-mois-csv?station_id=07156&mois=", month(Sys.Date()), "&annee=", year(Sys.Date())-2000)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(-7) %>%
  #filter(!is.na(mean_temp)) %>%
  mutate(mois = month(Sys.Date()),
         jour = parse_number(Jour),
         annee = paste0("20", year(Sys.Date())-2000) %>% as.numeric,
         date = as.Date(ISOdate(annee, mois, jour))) %>%
  select(-mois, - annee, -jour) %>%
  select(date, Jour, everything()) %>%
  arrange(desc(date)) %>%
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::opt_interactive(use_search = F,
                      use_pagination = F,
                      use_pagination_info = F,
                      use_compact_mode = T,
                      page_size_default = 20,
                      page_size_values = c(5, 10, 15, 20)) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    footnote = gt::md(paste0("Date: ", format(Sys.time(), "%A %d %B %Y, %Hh%M"), ". Source: <https://www.meteo60.fr/>"))
  ) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.width = "100%")
```
